# 📄 Pull Request Template

## Description
Please include a summary of the changes.

## Related Issue
- Closes #[issue_number]

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix 🐛
- [ ] New feature ✨
- [ ] Breaking change 💥
- [ ] Documentation update 📄

## Checklist
- [ ] I have tested the changes locally.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation if needed.
- [ ] I have reviewed my code and cleaned up debugging statements.
